1mzzs21:264: SkillComposer formulates agent skill selection as a closed-set skill sequence generation task, using a lightweight 3.9M-parameter decoder to jointly predict the skill subset, cardinality, and order. On SkillsBench, it raises GPT-5.2-Codex's pass rate from 22.2% to 45.3% (+23.1 pp), using 240K fewer prompt tokens than full-library loading. Core counterintuitive finding: TF-IDF sparse retrieval outperforms Dense Embedding on closed sets of short skill names, and a small specialized model (3.9M) beats a 600M full-parameter SFT by 19.3 pp Set F1 on held-out real tasks.
